Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma CosMx Data

Source: R/data.R
ccRCCExample.Rd

A core from a TMA of clear cell renal cell carcinoma samples subjected to single cell spatial transcriptomics with CosMx SMI.

data(ccRCCExample)

Format

## `ccRCCExample` A data frame with 7,122 rows and 12 columns:

Slide

Our slide identifier

x

centroid location in the x direction - in mm

y

centroid location in the y direction - in mm

cell_id

unique identifier for each cell

CD274

SCTransform scale.data (residuals) of CD274 (slide normalized)

PDCD1

SCTransform scale.data (residuals) of PDCD1 (slide normalized)

slide

run slide number

fov

slide FOV number

cell

FOV cell number

unique_fov

unique identifier for CosMx SMI imaging FOV

tma_core

combined FOV number relating back to the TMA core

unique_core

unique identifier for the TMA core given the slide and core

Source

Mitchell Hayes

Details

Coordinates are in millimetres, spanning roughly 1.02 x 1.02 mm with a median nearest-neighbour distance of 0.0073 mm. Bandwidths for this dataset therefore belong in the range 0.01 to 0.25, which corresponds to the 10-250 micrometre range used in the companion manuscript. Passing bandwidths of 10 or more drives every pairwise weight to approximately 1, making the kernel a constant matrix and collapsing Moran's I toward zero.
